title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 missing authorization in the Kubernetes integration allowed project…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in the Kubernetes integration of JetBrains TeamCity before versions 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 allows project viewers to access and use stored credentials. This flaw could lead to unauthorized use of credentials within the affected TeamCity instances.
